title: Fixative Preparation for Baermann Funnel Extraction
author: Casey A Schlenker

steps.title: Dissolve PFA in DI water
steps.instruction: Dissolve the PFA powder in 20 mL of de‑ionized water, then incubate in a 60 °C water bath for 40 minutes. Add 20 µL of 1 M NaOH, return to the 60 °C water bath for an additional 10 minutes, and finally remove and allow the solution to cool to room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Add PFA powder to 20 mL DI water.

steps.title: Prepare PBS solution
steps.instruction: Add two tablets of PBS to a 100 mL volumetric flask (fill to 100 mL with water if not already implied).

steps.title: Combine solutions for 4% formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Mix 20 mL of the dissolved PFA solution with 20 mL of the PBS solution to obtain a 4 % formaldehyde fixative.

steps.title: Add glycerol to fixative
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of glycerol to the 4 % formaldehyde mixture.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 7.5
steps.instruction: Check the pH of the fixative and adjust to pH 7.5 (using acid or base as needed).

steps.title: Warm fixative to 60 °C
steps.instruction: Place the fixative in a hot water bath and heat until the temperature reaches 60 °C.

steps.title: Final NaOH addition if needed
steps.instruction: If any solid remains undissolved, add an additional 10 µL of 1 M NaOH and mix.
